operations.name: Create Bookmark

operations.description: Moves a bookmark to the trash. To permanently delete it, empty the trash in Raindrop.io.

inputs.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark to delete. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).
inputs.label: Bookmark ID
inputs.name: raindrop_id

operations.name: Delete Bookmark

operations.description: Lists bookmarks from a collection, with optional keyword search

inputs.description: Filter bookmarks by keyword. Supports operators like #tag or type:article. Leave empty to list all bookmarks.
inputs.label: Search Query
inputs.name: search

inputs.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (max 50)
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.name: limit

operations.name: Find Bookmarks

operations.description: Retrieves the details of a bookmark by its ID

inputs.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).
inputs.label: Bookmark ID
inputs.name: raindrop_id

operations.name: Get Bookmark

inputs.name: raindrop_id

inputs.description: Updated short description or summary of the page
